definitions.explanation: The proper way of doing things; correct behavior.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{食事|しょくじ}{作法|さほう}では、{箸|はし}を{正|ただ}しく{持|も}つことが{大切|たいせつ}とされている。
examples.english: In Japanese dining etiquette, holding chopsticks correctly is considered important.

notes:
{作法|さほう} refers to proper manners.

COMMON USES:
- {食事|しょくじ}{作法|さほう} (table manners)
- {茶道|さどう}の{作法|さほう} (tea ceremony etiquette)
- {礼|れい}{儀|ぎ}{作法|さほう} (etiquette and manners)
- {作法|さほう}を{学|まな}ぶ (to learn manners)

SIMILAR:
- {作法|さほう}: manners, form (traditional)
- {礼儀|れいぎ}: courtesy, politeness
- マナー: manners (loanword)
